description: A test script for git-http-backend handling of CONTENT_LENGTH, including setup, environment configuration, and various test cases for HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Checks HTTP response status and error messages, compares actual and expected status.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables and invokes the Perl script to simulate HTTP requests.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Returns a size_t value just over SSIZE_MAX, used for testing overflow.
